dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped high-intensity (light) perimeters. The most prominent dorsal structures exhibit jagged, thin-walled geometries with a sharp contrast between the light-colored perimeter and the dark-grey interior/exterior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density. Small, localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels are present along the lower lateral boundary and anterior-dorsal region, appearing as solid punctate markers without internal textural gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary dorsal annulus and three secondary posterior clusters form a jagged polygonal relationship, with the longest vector established between the central dorsal structure and the most posterior grouping.
